points.description: States that the rear of the queue points to the tail of the linked list, so enqueue is done at the end (tail) of the list.
points.partial_credit: Half: names enqueue at the end/tail but does not link it to the rear pointer (or vice versa).

points.description: States that the front of the queue points to the head of the linked list, so dequeue is done at the beginning (head) of the list.
points.partial_credit: Half: names dequeue at the beginning/head but does not link it to the front pointer (or vice versa).

points.description: Gets the pairing right and distinct from the reverse: enqueue at tail/rear and dequeue at head/front, using the terms front, rear, head, tail, enqueue and dequeue correctly, with no swapped or contradictory statements.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both ends stated precisely: rear↔tail↔enqueue at end, and front↔head↔dequeue at beginning, using correct terms. Part marks only when clearly more than half of P1 or P2 is stated precisely. Vague answers ("use a linked list", "add and remove nodes") earn nothing, and any reversed pairing (e.g. enqueue at head) loses the affected points and P3.
